question: Has the settlement-lineage gate executed during a real production settlement?
verdict: PROVEN — the gate ran live and failed closed on a real board

evidence.violation: WRONG_EVENT_MAPPING: gamePk 824489 is claimed by 2 distinct events (mlb:cincinnati-reds-v-cleveland-guardians:20260728t1741, mlb:cincinnati-reds-v-cleveland-guardians:20260728t2310)
evidence.logExcerpt: pipeline.mlb.settlement_lineage.SettlementLineageError: Settlement 2026-07-28 failed lineage validation — refusing to write 641 row(s)

whyTheBoardIsCorrupt: The 2026-07-28 board was generated at ~10:15 ET on 2026-07-28 by mlb-daily-production. The publication gate that refuses a collided board landed in commit 1ccddf41 on 2026-07-28 at 21:23 ET — AFTER the board was written. So this board predates its own guard. Boards generated from 2026-07-29 onward are covered.

quarantine.rationale: Settling it would grade game 1's predictions against game 2's box score — the exact defect that produced 49 wrong outcomes in Sprint 044. Regenerating the board is not a fix either: the publication gate would now refuse to write it. Leaving the date unsettled is the correct outcome, and it is visible rather than silent.
violations: WRONG_EVENT_MAPPING: gamePk 824489 is claimed by 2 distinct events (mlb:cincinnati-reds-v-cleveland-guardians:20260728t1741, mlb:cincinnati-reds-v-cleveland-guardians:20260728t2310) — one event's predictions would be graded against the other's box score

secondaryDefectFound.what: scripts/automation_settle.sh reported '✓ MLB settlement completed' and exited 0 while the gate was raising.
secondaryDefectFound.cause: `if $PY -m ... | tee log; then` tests the pipeline's exit status, which bash defines as the status of the LAST command — `tee`, which always succeeds.
secondaryDefectFound.scope: 10 steps in the script, including both settlements and both exports. Every settlement failure since the script was written has been reported as success.
